name: github-workflows

coverage.//: Declared empty to preserve the repository standard target inventory, as scripts:coverage does; this private workflow tooling has executable subprocess and graph contracts but no separate coverage metric or new product coverage threshold.

//: llmlint: ignore-file[projects_stay_in_one_js_workspace,external_service_suite_stays_out_of_the_affected_tier] The task requires this private workflow-tooling project and lockfile to stay isolated from public SDK dependency resolution; its bootstrap installs only YAML, Actions expressions and budget reporting in .github. Its default input names the release plumbing the CD journeys under tests/ drive — scripts/release_cd.py and every script and manifest a CD job runs (the justfile is not one: its release recipes only name that script, and its other recipes would select these journeys for nothing) — so a change to how a release is produced selects them, while a change to a crate does not. The CD journeys' crate publication reads index.crates.io and static.crates.io without a credential — the public reads every cargo build in the affected tier already makes for its dependencies — through the double's index proxy and cargo's own verification build; they write only to loopback doubles, and dropping cargo's verification build to avoid them would stop proving each crate builds with its siblings resolved from a registry. JSON has no comment to scope this to the test target.
